criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slides 1 and 2 pass the showstopper test (one dominant crossover; census encoding exact) though the model reads as matte clay and the stripe floats as an untextured salmon bar. Failing: 8 (wheel with nobody behind it, no windshield road, grey panel, dek over busy geometry, stray vertical line), 5 (flat mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, plate continues left of the stop, brown groove, dead banded bottom), 3 (pool on far rows, near Avride rows murky, leaders cross roofs, 7 on its own dot, flat divider quads), 6 (cool blue cars, block skyline with a sphere, packed lot, empty bottom). Middling: 4, 7, 9.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck: lot motif changes state, stripe recurs, 9 reverses 1, value cut declared. Light and material drift (cream, grey, cool blue), casts toward camera on 6, values strobe from 4 to 8; 8 outside the world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; primary sources; rejected framings held back; freight releases kept off roster rows. The cover juxtaposes needs a state authorization with a report count that never says authorized.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What exists, who holds it, no fee no expiry, Dallas's ask and the answer, the enforcement line, a concrete action. No pending decision or deadline.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, turn at 5 and 6, close on an action; 4 mostly cuttable.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and specific, house rules hold, regional specificity on 8; some report-flat lines on 4 and 9.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh against 71 to 74; lastLight and a hero-object cover shared with 74; ranks of AVs on a dark lot in 52 and 67.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild slide 8 with the person's hands on the rim and the windshield, road and seam open beyond.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Wheel at right with no one behind it, person beside it, no windshield road or seam, speckled panel, dek over busy geometry, stray vertical.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Passenger-seat camera aimed so the wheel stands in front of the torso with hands on the rim, windshield open, panel and vertical removed, dek on the dark headliner.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, no hard start, brown groove, dead banded bottom third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: End the plate at a tall stop at the left edge, low raking key, higher shadow resolution, rule on its planned diagonal, true dusk_gold groove.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Pool on far rows, near Avride rows murky, leaders cross roofs, 7 collides with its dot, flat divider quads.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pool on the near rows, a label column whose leaders don't cross roofs, dividers as worn thermoplastic bars.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Cool blue cars against the key, casts toward camera, block skyline with a sphere, packed lot, empty bottom.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tail rows of single limestone cars under the -55 key casting right, camera lower, one hazed skyline silhouette.
